about.title: Rolling Hills Estates Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Rolling Hills Estates is a small place. With roughly 8,258 residents, a death on Palos Verdes Drive North or along Hawthorne Boulevard is not an abstraction here; it is someone the neighbors knew. Public records for 2025 show 15 injury collisions in the city, 19 people hurt, and one traffic death. California law gives certain survivors the right to bring a wrongful death claim. A spouse or registered domestic partner and the children come first; if there are none, other dependents and heirs may qualify. The claim is civil and moves on its own track, apart from any criminal case the Los Angeles County District Attorney might pursue. Recoverable losses include funeral and burial expenses, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. Timing matters. Most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter when a government entity is involved. We can review your situation at no cost to you.

whyChoose.title: Why Families in Rolling Hills Estates Choose Us

items.title: Standing is sorted out early
items.desc: California limits who may file a wrongful death claim, starting with the spouse or domestic partner and children, then certain dependents and heirs. We can confirm who qualifies before anything is filed.

items.title: The two-year clock is watched closely
items.desc: Most claims must be brought within two years of the date of death, and far sooner when a public agency is involved. We get involved early to protect that deadline.

items.title: No fee unless there is a recovery
items.desc: We work on contingency. Your family does not pay legal fees out of pocket while grieving.

items.question: My spouse died in a crash on Palos Verdes Drive North. Does it matter who maintains the road?
items.answer: It can. If a claim involves a city, county, or state agency, such as one responsible for road design or maintenance, California requires a formal notice within a much shorter period than the usual two years. We can look at the specifics of the Palos Verdes Drive North stretch where the crash happened and determine whether a public entity is a potential defendant. That review should happen quickly.

items.question: The driver is facing criminal charges in Los Angeles County. Do we have to wait?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action, and it proceeds separately from any criminal case brought by the district attorney. A conviction is not required for your family to pursue compensation, though evidence from the criminal matter may be useful. We can explain how the two tracks interact in your case.

items.question: What losses can our family actually recover?
items.answer: California allows recovery of funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have contributed over their lifetime, and the loss of love, companionship, comfort, and guidance. Each family's situation is different, so no one can predict a specific result. We can walk through what applies to you.
